subject: Vendor onboarding: PO flow and billing-window alignment for GreenLeaf Analytics
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan@greenleafanalytics.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@greenleafanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup / preferred payment terms

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — GreenLeaf is excited to start the integration. Finance is ready to move forward with vendor setup but we need to confirm a few items so we can get POs flowing. Quick questions: 

- Our standard is Net 45. Does Redwood accept Net 45 on regular invoicing?
- We also have a request to evaluate an early-pay option (1.25% discount if paid in 10 days) for the first two months to help cashflow while traffic ramps. Is Redwood able to support early-pay discounts/alternate remittance rails?
- Do you require a W-9 and a signed onboarding form from us? I attached our vendor W-9 and the onboarding workbook.

If you can confirm who on your side will own PO issuance and the preferred invoice header format, we can update our AP team.

Thanks,
Susan Park
Head of Partnerships
GreenLeaf Analytics
Attachments: GreenLeaf_W9.pdf, GreenLeaf_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@greenleafanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / preferred payment terms

Hi Susan — welcome, and great to have GreenLeaf moving forward. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Net 45: We can accept Net 45 for standard onboarding. Our default is Net 30, but Net 45 is fine for this account while you ramp.
- Early-pay discount: We have an early-pay program but it requires an enrollment step in our AP portal and sign-off from Finance for the pilot. 1.25% for payment within 10 days is within reason, I'll route to David for eligibility and cadence confirmation.
- Required docs: Yes — W-9 and the completed vendor onboarding workbook are required. You attached them, thanks. We also need a remittance email and the exact invoice header you want on our PO.

Marissa — looping you in to start the vendor setup (attachments included above). David, could you confirm whether Finance can greenlight the 1.25% early-pay pilot for the first 60 days? If yes, we should document the discount window and create a PO lane that flags early-pay eligible invoices.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to create vendor record and send DocuSign onboarding packet.
2) David to confirm early-pay pilot approval + accounting workflow.
3) Avery to confirm PO header and expected monthly volume for capacity planning.

Susan, if you can confirm the invoice header (company legal name, tax ID shown on the W-9, and preferred remittance email), we'll kick off.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@greenleafanalytics.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / preferred payment terms

Hi Susan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the docs. I started the vendor record in our onboarding tracker and attached the items you'll need to sign. A few procedural notes so we align expectations: 

- Onboarding form: Please fill the second tab of the workbook with the invoice header, remit-to email, and a vendor contact for PO questions. We use that to populate PO templates so your invoices won't be rejected for header mismatch.
- PO issuance: Redwood will issue a standard PO per engagement. POs will route to GreenLeaf via vendor portal email; please confirm the remit address for that channel.
- Billing cadence: We'll set your default invoice term to Net 45 as requested. For the early-pay discount pilot: Finance requires a one-page amendment to the vendor record specifying the discount percentage, the eligible invoice dates, and the accounting GL that will absorb the cost. Once David signs off, we'll add a flag on the vendor record so AP can apply the discount automatically when invoices are processed within the 10-day window.

Action items for GreenLeaf:
- Confirm invoice header and remit email (reply to this thread).
- Sign the onboarding workbook and return via the DocuSign link I will send in a separate email.

I've attached a short checklist and our onboarding PO template for your reference.

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, Redwood_PO_Template.docx

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@greenleafanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / preferred payment terms

Avery/Marissa — I reviewed the proposed early-pay pilot. Finance can approve a short pilot under these conditions: 

1) Limit pilot to invoices issued between 2026-08-15 and 2026-10-15 (60 days).
2) Early-pay discount: 1.0% for payments made within 10 calendar days (slightly lower than requested to stay within program parameters).
3) GreenLeaf must be set up with automated remittance (ACH) and accept a PO header validation step to avoid manual matching exceptions.
4) Redwood will track early-pay usage and report monthly; we reserve the right to pause if fraud/match errors exceed threshold.

Marissa: please add the amendment to the vendor record with the pilot window and 1.0% discount. Avery: once GreenLeaf confirms the invoice header and remittance email, I will provision the accounting flag and notify AP to apply the pilot discount.

Susan: happy to onboard — if you confirm the remit email and legal header now, we can have the PO lane live before your first invoice.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
